decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith( Existing 0672.1 Rev A received 29/3/11
Amended plan 0672.3 REV G received 25/8/11
Car park management Plan received 24/8/11
Statement of products received 13/12/11 ) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - Samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the front boundaery screen shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority within two months of the date of this permission.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
Condition : 3 - The front boundary treatment shall be put in place in accordance with the hereby approved plans within three months of the date of this permission and permanently retained.

Condition : 4 - The use of the site for car washing shall only be undertaken using the chemicals and cleaning equipment specified in the Statement received. No other chemicals or cleaning equipment that are not biodegradable shall be used without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted for hand car wash purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 08.30-19.00 Mon-Sat and 09.00-18.30 Sun & Bank Hol).

Condition : 7 - The rating level of noise emitted from activities on the site, shall not exceed the background noise level. The noise levels shall be determined at the nearest noise sensitive locations. The measurements shall be made according to BS4142:1997.

Condition : 8 - The use of the site for car washing shall not obstruct the free usage of the Kwik Fit site, and shall only occur within the designated parking bays as indicated on drawing 0672.3 REV G, unless by prior written agreement from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 10 - If within a period of (five years) from the date of the planting of any tree, that tree, or any tree planted in replacement for it, is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, (or becomes, in the opinion of the local planning authority, seriously damaged or defective,) another tree of the same species and size as that originally planted shall be planted at the same place, unless the local planning authority gives its written consent to any variation.
description: Change of use from a petrol filling station to hand car wash with valet facilities.
